rules.description: beneficiary under 18 on the date of service
rules.denial_reason: Beneficiary is under 18 on the date of service. LCD L33822 criterion 1.2 requires age 18 or older.
Reported ICD-10-CM code is not listed in Section 5. Covered codes are E10.9, E11.9, E11.65, E13.9.
Billed HCPCS code is outside the scope of LCD L33822 and is denied as not covered. Covered codes are K0554, K0553, A4239, E2103.

rules.description: not treated with insulin by injections or pump
rules.denial_reason: Diabetes is managed without insulin therapy. Criterion 1.3 requires three or more daily injections or an insulin infusion pump.

rules.description: fewer than 4 fingerstick tests per day
rules.denial_reason: Documented fingerstick testing is below the minimum of 4 per day required by criterion 1.4 in revision 2.0.

rules.description: no documented failure of prior therapy
rules.denial_reason: Medical record does not document failure of prior therapy over a trial of at least 3 months, required by criterion 1.7.

rules.description: no practitioner visit within 6 months of the order
rules.denial_reason: No in-person visit with the treating practitioner within the 6 months prior to the written order, required by criterion 1.5.
